about: Laughing Leo shows Leonardo DiCaprio as plantation owner Calvin Candie in Django Unchained (2012), leaning back at a dinner table in a fine suit with a white carnation, a small glass of drink raised in one hand and his face scrunched into a smug, mocking laugh. It is the reaction for laughing at someone's naive statement or obvious bad decision, the face you make when someone says a project will be finished by Friday. The drink in his hand also makes it a popular base for edits that swap in other beverages.
origin: The frame is from Quentin Tarantino's Django Unchained (2012). It circulated as an edited image from 2017, often with an energy drink pasted into his hand, and became a widely used reaction image around 2020.
usage:
The top box is the setup, usually "when they say" or "me when". The bottom box is the naive or delusional statement Leo is laughing at, often in quotes. Example: "when they say" / "'it should be a quick fix'".

It works best for claims everybody knows are wrong: "it's only a 5 minute walk", "the update won't take long", "we'll win the league this year", "I'll just watch one episode". Keep the quoted line short so the smirk lands in one glance.
